title: FOOD TOUR KOH SAMUI NIGHT MARKET
description:
FOOD TOUR KOH SAMUI NIGHT MARKET

We love food and we love night markets... so we couldn't miss out on the Fisherman's Village night market in Koh Samui! We ate tons of delicious food, and a few things that we didn't love. Plus Amanda got to shop her little a$$ off.

Fishermans' Village Night Market: http://www.kosamui.com/bophut/fishermans-village-walking-street.htm
